newsitem.title: USA: Colonial BancGroup completes Fla. deals.
newsitem.headline: Colonial BancGroup completes Fla. deals.

text.p: Colonial BancGroup Inc said it completed the acquisitions of two Florida based banks, First Commerce Banks of Florida Inc, located in Winter Haven, and Great Southern Bancorp of West Palm Beach.
Assets for First Commerce and Great Southern totaled $106 million and $124 million, respectively. Each operated five branches in central Florida.

Colonial BancGroup, headquartered in Montgomery, Ala., now has $6 billion in assets and 181 branches throughout Alabama, Florida, Georgia and Tennessee. All of Colonial's separate state banking operations have now been merged into its Alabama bank, the company said in a statement.
